outcome: Publish Tasktra as a security-reviewed public GitHub repository after removing workstation-specific data from the full reachable history.
motivation: The human explicitly authorized making mattazz/Tasktra public and requested a security review first. This envelope permits only the bounded history sanitation, reviewed commit, guarded push, and visibility change needed for that outcome, without paid services.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The tracked tree and public main history contain no live credentials or local workstation paths.
GitHub reports mattazz/Tasktra as public and origin/main equals the locally verified publication commit.

quality_requirements: Keep the repository private until the sanitized history is pushed and verified.
Preserve the two existing commit messages and authorship while replacing only the sensitive receipt blob in their reachable history.
Use an exact force-with-lease bound to origin main at 8dd11a85f4fe958042fb9c42336f400cced3dc98.
Do not print or persist GitHub credentials or lease tokens.
Pin third-party workflow actions to reviewed commit SHAs and retain least-privilege workflow permissions.
Verify the final public visibility and exact main object independently after mutation.
stop_conditions: Origin main is not exactly 8dd11a85f4fe958042fb9c42336f400cced3dc98 before the guarded push.
A live credential or additional private path is detected.
The push or visibility result is indeterminate and cannot be reconciled through the configured adapter.
Any requested action would spend money or modify a repository setting other than visibility.
escalation_conditions: The provider adapter cannot prove the exact remote ref or repository visibility.
The security-reviewed working tree changes before publication.
